description: external_links_search — FS-curated third-party links for Massachusetts, INCLUDING a MyHeritage entry for the 1855 Massachusetts State Census (collection-20822) — a collection FamilySearch also holds itself (see collections-search-massachusetts-census, FS collection 1459985). This is the fixture behind the collections-fs-holdings test (issue #1313): the skill surfaces the MyHeritage census link and must note that FamilySearch also holds the same collection rather than present MyHeritage as the sole source. The business-directory, death-index, and Ancestry cemetery entries are realistic neighbours the skill filters past. The predicate matches any standardPlace because each test loads exactly one external-links fixture. Links are verbatim from a live external_links_search('Massachusetts, United States') on 2026-08-10.
